reason: Every night I sit calling the boys and writing up jobs, bills and AMC dates myself, and customers still argue about which part was changed. The first month is free, I only pay if my technicians actually use it, and ₹999 is less than one AC service call, so I will try it.
objection: Will it really understand my technicians speaking Tamil and Tanglish on a noisy rooftop with the compressor running? If the reports come out wrong I will be correcting them at night anyway, and my older technicians may not bother pressing the button.
would_change_my_mind: If in the first week the reports come out garbled from real rooftop jobs and I have to rewrite them, I will drop it.
